title: Live MED+250 production deployment route test
summary: The fail-soft catalogue release was deployed to the production custom domain and passed required-route verification, repeated HTTP sampling, and desktop and mobile browser checks.

checks.name: Required routes
checks.detail: The home, categories, medicines, product, robots, sitemap, and manifest routes each returned HTTP 200.

checks.name: Search index controls
checks.detail: The live origin permits indexing, publishes the production sitemap origin, and includes more than the minimum product URL count.

checks.name: Current release assets
checks.detail: Cloudflare deployed production version 431f38e3-4b6c-47cd-94a8-2d1adc0442a5 from the checked production build.

checks.name: Fresh live deployment verification
checks.detail: The seven-route verifier passed against the live custom origin, and the explicit production build and strict Cloudflare dry run completed without errors.

checks.name: Repeated route availability
checks.detail: Ten requests to each of nine public catalogue, category, product, robots, and sitemap routes completed successfully, for ninety HTTP 200 responses.

checks.name: Desktop and mobile browser behavior
checks.detail: Desktop Makeup filtering rendered populated cards without blank taxonomy or placeholder price labels, while mobile navigation exposed only the five populated catalogue links; neither pass recorded browser or server errors.
